_comment_dataGroups: Intentionally OMITTED. Dynamic, auth'd, per-org API responses (/api/sites, /api/auth/me, /api/analytics/*, …) must NEVER be cached or freshness-proxied by the Angular service worker. A `freshness` DataGroup with a `timeout` REJECTS on slow/failed egress — surfacing as `ngsw-worker.js DataGroup.safeFetch → Uncaught TypeError: Failed to fetch` — and a rejected /api/sites blocks selectedSite() so the persistent bolt editor iframe never boots (no files). It also risks serving one org's cached sites to another. API calls go straight to the network; AdminStateService/ApiService own their own 30s timeout + catchError. The SW caches the app shell + static assets only (assetGroups below).
